In the diagram, $Z$ lies on the segment $BP$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{BO}=k$ and $\overrightarrow{OP}=f$. The lengths satisfy $BZ:ZP=1:3$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OZ}$ in terms of $k$ and $f$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$\overrightarrow{OZ}=$ {{field-1}} $k+$ {{field-2}} $f$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OB}=-k\qquad \overrightarrow{OP}=f .
$$

Trace the path from $B$ through $O$ to $P$:

$$
\overrightarrow{BP}=\overrightarrow{BO}+\overrightarrow{OP}=k+f.
$$

The ratio $BZ:ZP=1:3$ gives $4$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{BZ}=\frac{1}{4}\overrightarrow{BP}=\frac{1}{4}(k+f).
$$

Add along the path $O\to B\to Z$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OZ}&=\overrightarrow{OB}+\overrightarrow{BZ}\\&=-k+\frac{1}{4}(k+f)\\&=-\frac{3}{4}k+\frac{1}{4}f.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\overrightarrow{OL}=-k\qquad \overrightarrow{OV}=h .

$$

$$
